curl 8.23.0 for Apple silicon, statically linked with LibreSSL 4.4.1.

source=https://curl.se/download/curl-8.23.0.tar.xz
source_sha256=8dadd7d2536a314f982ad05a651b713f426bf7d02cc2c76cffb9796f2218e6c5
libressl_source=https://github.com/libressl/portable/releases/download/v4.4.1/libressl-4.4.1.tar.gz
libressl_sha256=290cdf1b53c086255dc302f118b98602a444e9ae6d11e9bfdd8c9b1b60aa3a22

Secure Transport was removed from curl in 8.15.0, so this build does not use it.
LibreSSL is configured with a generic prefix, static only:

  --host=aarch64-apple-darwin24.5
  --build=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
  --prefix=/opt/hfmd/libressl
  --disable-shared
  --enable-static

curl is configured with:

  --host=aarch64-apple-darwin24.5
  --build=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
  --disable-shared
  --enable-static
  --with-openssl=/opt/hfmd/libressl
  --with-apple-sectrust
  --without-gnutls
  --without-mbedtls
  --without-wolfssl
  --without-rustls
  --without-amissl
  --without-zlib
  --without-brotli
  --without-zstd
  --without-libpsl
  --without-libssh2
  --without-nghttp2
  --without-nghttp3
  --without-ngtcp2
  --without-libidn2
  --without-ca-bundle
  --without-ca-path
  --disable-ldap
  --disable-ldaps
  --disable-manual

Compiler target aarch64-apple-darwin24.5, minimum OS 11.0, SDK MacOSX15.5.
Linker ld64.lld 14. The link writes LC_CODE_SIGNATURE. The SHA256 in PIN.txt
is of those final bytes. Do not replace this file with a Homebrew or system curl.
Dynamic libraries are only libSystem and the Security, CoreFoundation,
CoreServices, and SystemConfiguration frameworks.
